items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Nat and I became neighbors... We really became fast friends then and there... traveling around together and performing together and recording together.

ctx.x: Maybe we could go [now] to the group that you had with Freddie Hubbard.
Actually it was with Nat Adderley.
Nat Adderley first, right. Let's go to that group first.
